name: Shrimp-cake noodles
summary: Bún suông is a breakfast VnExpress names along the Hậu landing and at Chợ Châu Đốc, beside hủ tiếu and bún mắm. That Châu Đốc day does not print a recipe. On a Trà Vinh list, the same publisher describes bún suông as rice noodles and a fresh shrimp cake in a pork-bone broth. That description is the Trà Vinh bowl.
origin: Named for a Châu Đốc breakfast on VnExpress, 20 Oct 2023. The method below is the Trà Vinh list, not a Châu Đốc recipe.
howToEat: Order it in the morning with the other landing bowls. A Châu Đốc method was not printed. Check on arrival.

VnExpress’s Trà Vinh list says bún suông is rice noodles and fresh shrimp cake. The broth is pork bones, seasoned, and some cooks add dried shrimp or dried squid. The sides named there are shredded cabbage, onion, coriander, ground-soybean sauce, lime, and chili.
The Trà Vinh list printed 15,000–25,000 VND a bowl. No Châu Đốc price was printed. Check on arrival.
where: Along the Hậu landing and at Chợ Châu Đốc, for breakfast. A house number was not printed. Check on arrival.
seoDescription: Bún suông is a Châu Đốc breakfast on the Hậu landing and at the market. VnExpress describes the shrimp-cake bowl on a Trà Vinh list, not as a Châu Đốc recipe.
